summary: Allied Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 17, 2026 press release updating commissioning progress at its Kurmuk Mine in Ethiopia. The registrant reported the 88-kilometre, 132-kV power line to the Ethiopian grid was commissioned and energized under a 20-year power purchase agreement with Ethiopian Electric Power at roughly US$0.04 per kWh, and that first ore reached the crushing circuit this month. Mining and ore stockpiling continue ahead of ramp-up, with first ore to the grinding circuit expected in coming weeks. This is an operational milestone disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics were stated.
